text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared repository. Each time code is added, automated builds start immediately, so the software is always ready to use. During these builds, the system automatically runs tests to check that everything works correctly. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become serious problems. CI pipelines organise all these steps, from building to testing, into a clear and repeatable process. As a result, teams can fix bugs faster, save time, and release better software more often.
